description: A quarterly NGO invoice register has live line-total, monthly-subtotal, and grand-total formulas but no cached formula results.

questions.question: What is the total invoice spend in INR? Calculate each invoice line as Quantity × Unit Rate, and ignore monthly subtotal and grand total rows.
questions.trap: The live formula cells have no cached values and appear blank in data-only reads.

questions.question: What is the total computed spend in INR for Community Nutrition in Odisha, using Quantity × Unit Rate for each invoice line?
questions.trap: Summing the uncached Line Amount column yields blanks instead of spend.

questions.question: How many distinct invoice IDs are funded by rows whose Funding Type is exactly 'Government Scheme'? Count invoice detail rows only.
questions.trap: Month labels and subtotal rows are interspersed with invoice rows.

questions.question: Which district has the highest total computed spend after calculating Quantity × Unit Rate for every invoice?
questions.trap: Ranking blank cached formula cells or the largest single invoice is wrong.

questions.question: What percentage of total computed invoice spend is funded by rows whose Funding Type is 'Foreign Grant'? Use Quantity × Unit Rate and round to two decimals.
questions.trap: The percentage must be derived from inputs, not uncached formula results.
